patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section dominated by oversized typography, with a secondary horizontal scroll of small, diverse visual content.
Content sections utilize a clean, single-column layout with generous vertical spacing, transitioning to a two-column layout for interactive elements like the 'What We Offer' section.
Extreme contrast in type scale, featuring a massive, bold sans-serif display font for key branding elements and much smaller, functional sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A stark black and white primary palette is dramatically interrupted by a vibrant yellow, which serves as both an accent and a full-section background for the footer.
The main navigation bar transforms from transparent to a solid yellow background and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after a short scroll depth.
The entire page background shifts from white to a vibrant yellow as the user scrolls down, revealing a large, distinct footer area with a new color context.
The 'Good Sound' text within the footer animates from a fluid, distorted shape into its legible, bold form as it comes into view.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that changes its background color from transparent to a solid yellow after the user scrolls past the initial hero content, providing a clear visual cue for its fixed state.

A full-page background color transition is used, where the main content area scrolls up to reveal a new, distinct background color (yellow) that defines the entire footer section, creating a dramatic visual shift.

The footer features a large text element that animates its shape and form, starting as an abstract, fluid graphic and resolving into clear, legible text as it enters the viewport, adding a dynamic brand expression.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif display text (~8x body) contrasts with small, uppercase sans-serif labels and a legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used consistently across all elements, including buttons, images, and content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in hero and main content sections, with a balanced density in feature grids and navigation elements.

standout: This site stands out with its audacious use of oversized, animated typography as a primary design element, particularly the dynamic, fluid 'Good Sound' text in the footer. The dramatic full-page background color shift from white to a vibrant yellow upon scroll also creates a memorable and distinctive user experience, moving beyond typical section-based background changes.
